approval.statement: Владелец утвердил ADR-005, вариант B, и OD-010D-01…05 с обязательными уточнениями A–D к Stage B: идемпотентный транзакционный backfill только QUARANTINED документов; коррелируемый контролируемый operator retry без атрибуции произвольному StaffUser и без production-разрешения; attestation готовности/движка/загруженных сигнатур в начале и перед finalize с fail-closed при разрыве непрерывности; no-write finalize replay только для точной версии, lease-token hash и результата. Одобрено на исходном PR #26 HEAD 1cad9fbb210ded32b07cee3923bec8ab011768a8.
approval.scope: Authorizes isolated Stage B implementation and testing only. No production migration, deployment, real-document processing, production operator retry, public launch or production permission provisioning. Existing FROZEN R1-010 1.0.2 and decisions 1–108 remain unchanged.

clarifications.rule: Backfill pre-existing QUARANTINED rows in the additive migration transaction; copy immutable storage key, SHA-256 and size; exclude all terminal rows; ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.
Operator retry requires an audit correlation ID for a controlled runbook, operator journal or incident/change ticket; it is test-profile-only until production attribution is separately approved.
Check readiness, engine and loaded-signature metadata/age before scan and immediately before finalize; changed or unprovable continuity fails closed.
No-write finalize replay is accepted only for the exact completed version, lease-token hash and canonical result fingerprint; stale, conflicting or unauthorized finalize fails.

finalization.description: Owner-approved additive clarification was incorporated into a new R1-010D 1.0.0 frozen security contract. No existing FROZEN R1-010 contract artifact or public API was changed.
